uq.title: Upload Question
uq.subtitle: Create and upload new questions to the TopKorbo question bank with LaTeX formatting.
uq.section.type.desc: Choose whether this is a Multiple Choice (MCQ) or Written question.
uq.section.cq.desc: HSC Creative Questions consist of exactly four sub-questions (a, b, c, d). LaTeX is supported.
uq.cq.error.parts_required: Please fill all four sub-questions (a, b, c, d).
uq.section.question: Question Body (LaTeX)
uq.section.question.desc: Write your question using LaTeX syntax. Use $...$ for inline math and $$...$$ for display math.
uq.question.placeholder: Type your question here… e.g. What is the value of $\int_0^1 x^2 dx$?
uq.section.options.desc: Add 2 to 4 answer options. Mark the correct answer. LaTeX is supported in options.
uq.section.classification.desc: Categorize the question by HSC subject, paper, chapter, and topic.
uq.field.subject: Subject
uq.section.tags.desc: Tag this question with board exam, college, or university admission metadata for categorization.
uq.error.min_options: MCQ must have at least 2 filled options.
uq.error.correct_required: Please mark one option as correct.
